howto.what: 装上后，Codex Rules 会自动生效：在会话开始和用户提交提示时注入静态项目规则；在应用补丁后注入匹配的文件特定规则；动态输出作为额外上下文注入并去重，不改写工具输出。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 行为、项目规则注入、支持的文件位置等话题时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些项目规则文件？
动态规则是在什么时候注入的？
say.note: 在 apply_patch 后注入匹配文件规则。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Codex Rules runs automatically: it injects static project instructions on SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, injects matching file rules after apply_patch, and adds deduplicated dynamic context. It never rewrites tool output.
howto.when_en: When the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, project rule injection, supported file locations, etc.

say_en.text: What project rule files does Codex Rules support?
say_en.note: Lists supported locations like CONTEXT.md and .omo/rules.
Explains valid values: both, static, dynamic, off.
